A piece of waste or uncultivated land, desert or bare soil; a desert,
 waste; खिले गा विष्ठिता इव
An additional hymn appended to the regular collection;
Remainder; अलं दग्धैर्द्रुमैर्दीनैः खिलानां शिवमस्तु नः

खिलः, -लम् + .{@-लः@} N. of Brahmā and of Viṣṇu. [खिल is often used in
 combination with भू and कृ; (1) खिलीभू
——(a) to become impassable, to be blocked up, be left unfrequented;
 खिलीभूते विमानानां तदापातभयात्पथि

.
——(b) to be impossible, be rendered impracticable or stopped; प्रजागरात्खिलीभूतस्तस्याः
 स्वप्नसमागमः Ś. 6. 22. (2) खिलीकृ means
——(a) to obstruct, impede, make impassable, block up; तौ सुकेतसुतया
 खिलीकृते

.
——(b) to lay waste, devastate, put down or vanquish completely; विपक्षमखिलीकृत्य
 प्रतिष्ठा खलु दुर्लभा Śi. 2. 34.]

A piece of waste or uncultivated land, desert or bare soil; a desert,
 waste; खिले गा विष्ठिता इव
An additional hymn appended to the regular collection;
Remainder; अलं दग्धैर्द्रुमैर्दीनैः खिलानां शिवमस्तु नः
A desert; उत खिल्या उर्वराणां भवन्ति
A piece of rock in the earth; अभिन्ने खिल्ये नि दधाति देवयुम्
